questions.question: Are the E/F B advantages after common repair and the A failures explicit?
questions.evidence: All four paired E/F comparisons retain B; original/43 and shorter/43 explicitly fail A. Continuous phase improvements do not replace full A decisions, and sensitivity records are not independent runs.

questions.question: Does the advantage persist against F_cov without a single-factor spatial, temporal or VJP causal claim?
questions.evidence: Two valid endpoints retain E advantages; spatial/fine current reductions are 52.68% and 66.55%. The spatial support and temporal measure change together; F_cov/F adverse support metrics and failed original A/B decisions remain visible.

questions.question: Are D_E and B_E actively presented as main-text counterexamples?
questions.evidence: D_E improves the selected phase and port errors while retaining electrical feedback. B_E reverses current/power directions for original/43/fine under old and refined references; the opposite spatial-reference direction and original false A/B decisions remain explicit.

questions.question: Are unqualified VJP causality, universal superiority and material-validation claims absent?
questions.evidence: Claims are bounded to a synthetic two-dimensional known-model configuration comparison; co-varying initialization, variables, enforcement, time support and gradients are disclosed. Auxiliary fitted VO2 lumped-model results are not material validation. Actual work counts are not converted into speed or equal-cost superiority.
